steps.title: v16 node support
steps.action: Make sure that you are using a supported version of node.js before you upgrade your application. Angular v16 supports node.js versions: v16 and v18.

steps.title: v16 ts support
steps.action: Make sure that you are using a supported version of TypeScript before you upgrade your application. Angular v16 supports TypeScript version 4.9.3 or later.

steps.title: v16 ng update
steps.action: In the application's project directory, run `ng update @angular/core@16 @angular/cli@16` to update your application to Angular v16.

steps.title: v16 zone.js support
steps.action: Make sure that you are using a supported version of Zone.js before you upgrade your application. Angular v16 supports Zone.js version 0.13.x or later.

steps.title: v16 RouterEvent
steps.action: The Event union no longer contains `RouterEvent`, which means that if you're using the Event type you may have to change the type definition from `(e: Event)` to `(e: Event|RouterEvent)`

steps.title: v16 routerEvent prop type
steps.action: In addition to `NavigationEnd` the `routerEvent` property now also accepts type `NavigationSkipped`

steps.title: v16 RendererType2
steps.action: Pass only flat arrays to `RendererType2.styles` because it no longer accepts nested arrays

steps.title: v16 BrowserPlatformLocation
steps.action: You may have to update tests that use `BrowserPlatformLocation` because `MockPlatformLocation` is now provided by default in tests. [Read further](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#common-9).

steps.title: v16 ngcc
steps.action: Due to the removal of the Angular Compatibility Compiler (ngcc) in v16, projects on v16 and later no longer support View Engine libraries.

steps.title: v16 createUrlTree
steps.action: After bug fixes in `Router.createUrlTree` you may have to readjust tests which mock `ActivatedRoute`. [Read further](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#1600-2023-05-03)

steps.title: v16 ApplicationConfig imports
steps.action: Change imports of `ApplicationConfig` to be from `@angular/core`.

steps.title: v16 renderModule
steps.action: Revise your code to use `renderModule` instead of `renderModuleFactory` because it has been deleted.

steps.title: v16 XhrFactory
steps.action: Revise your code to use `XhrFactory` from `@angular/common` instead of `XhrFactory` export from `@angular/common/http`.

steps.title: v16 withServerTransition
steps.action: If you're running multiple Angular apps on the same page and you're using `BrowserModule.withServerTransition({ appId: 'serverApp' })` make sure you set the `APP_ID` instead since `withServerTransition` is now deprecated. [Read further](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#platform-browser-4)

steps.title: v16 EnvironmentInjector
steps.action: Change `EnvironmentInjector.runInContext` to `runInInjectionContext` and pass the environment injector as the first parameter.

steps.title: v16 ViewContainerRef.createComponent
steps.action: Update your code to use `ViewContainerRef.createComponent` without the factory resolver. `ComponentFactoryResolver` has been removed from Router APIs.

steps.title: v16 APP_ID
steps.action: If you bootstrap multiple apps on the same page, make sure you set unique `APP_IDs`.

steps.title: v16 server renderApplication
steps.action: Update your code to revise `renderApplication` method as it no longer accepts a root component as first argument, but instead a callback that should bootstrap your app. [Read further](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#platform-server-3)

steps.title: v16 PlatformConfig.baseUrl
steps.action: Update your code to remove any reference to `PlatformConfig.baseUrl` and `PlatformConfig.useAbsoluteUrl` platform-server config options as it has been deprecated.

steps.title: v16 moduleid
steps.action: Update your code to remove any reference to `@Directive`/`@Component` `moduleId` property as it does not have any effect and will be removed in v17.

steps.title: v16 transfer state imports
steps.action: Update imports from `import {makeStateKey, StateKey, TransferState} from '@angular/platform-browser'` to `import {makeStateKey, StateKey, TransferState} from '@angular/core'`

steps.title: v16 ComponentRef
steps.action: If you rely on `ComponentRef.setInput` to set the component input even if it's the same based on `Object.is` equality check, make sure you copy its value.

steps.title: v16 ANALYZE_FOR_ENTRY_COMPONENTS
steps.action: Update your code to remove any reference to `ANALYZE_FOR_ENTRY_COMPONENTS` injection token as it has been deleted.

steps.title: v16 entry components
steps.action: `entryComponents` is no longer available and any reference to it can be removed from the `@NgModule` and `@Component` public APIs.

steps.title: v16 ngTemplateOutletContext
steps.action: ngTemplateOutletContext has stricter type checking which requires you to declare all the properties in the corresponding object. [Read further](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#common-1).

steps.title: v16 APF
steps.action: Angular packages no longer include FESM2015 and the distributed ECMScript has been updated from 2020 to 2022.

steps.title: v16 EventManager
steps.action: The deprecated `EventManager` method `addGlobalEventListener` has been removed as it is not used by Ivy.

steps.title: v16 BrowserTransferStateModule
steps.action: `BrowserTransferStateModule` is no longer available and any reference to it can be removed from your applications.

steps.title: v16 ReflectiveInjector
steps.action: Update your code to use `Injector.create` rather than `ReflectiveInjector` since `ReflectiveInjector` is removed.

steps.title: v16 QueryList
steps.action: `QueryList.filter` now supports type guard functions. Since the type will be narrowed, you may have to update your application code that relies on the old behavior.

steps.title: v17 node support
steps.action: Make sure that you are using a supported version of node.js before you upgrade your application. Angular v17 supports node.js versions: v18.13.0 and newer

steps.title: v17 ts support
steps.action: Make sure that you are using a supported version of TypeScript before you upgrade your application. Angular v17 supports TypeScript version 5.2 or later.

steps.title: v17 zone.js support
steps.action: Make sure that you are using a supported version of Zone.js before you upgrade your application. Angular v17 supports Zone.js version 0.14.x or later.

steps.title: v17 ng update
steps.action: In the application's project directory, run `ng update @angular/core@17 @angular/cli@17` to update your application to Angular v17.

steps.title: v17 style removal
steps.action: Angular now automatically removes styles of destroyed components, which may impact your existing apps in cases you rely on leaked styles. To change this update the value of the `REMOVE_STYLES_ON_COMPONENT_DESTROY` provider to `false`.

steps.title: v17 router removals
steps.action: Make sure you configure `setupTestingRouter`, `canceledNavigationResolution`, `paramsInheritanceStrategy`, `titleStrategy`, `urlUpdateStrategy`, `urlHandlingStrategy`, and `malformedUriErrorHandler` in `provideRouter` or `RouterModule.forRoot` since these properties are now not part of the `Router`'s public API

steps.title: v17 ngDoCheck dynamic components
steps.action: For dynamically instantiated components we now execute `ngDoCheck` during change detection if the component is marked as dirty. You may need to update your tests or logic within `ngDoCheck` for dynamically instantiated components.

steps.title: v17 malformedUriErrorHandler
steps.action: Handle URL parsing errors in the `UrlSerializer.parse` instead of `malformedUriErrorHandler` because it's now part of the public API surface.

steps.title: v17 zone deep imports
steps.action: Change Zone.js deep imports like `zone.js/bundles/zone-testing.js` and `zone.js/dist/zone` to `zone.js` and `zone.js/testing`.

steps.title: v17 absolute redirects
steps.action: You may need to adjust your router configuration to prevent infinite redirects after absolute redirects. In v17 we no longer prevent additional redirects after absolute redirects.

steps.title: v17 AnimationDriver
steps.action: Change references to `AnimationDriver.NOOP` to use `NoopAnimationDriver` because `AnimationDriver.NOOP` is now deprecated.

steps.title: v17 switch strictness
steps.action: You may need to adjust the equality check for `NgSwitch` because now it defaults to stricter check with `===` instead of `==`. Angular will log a warning message for the usages where you'd need to provide an adjustment.

steps.title: v17 mutate in signals
steps.action: Use `update` instead of `mutate` in Angular Signals. For example `items.mutate(itemsArray => itemsArray.push(newItem));` will now be `items.update(itemsArray => [itemsArray, …newItem]);`

steps.title: v17 withNoDomReuse
steps.action: To disable hydration use `ngSkipHydration` or remove the `provideClientHydration` call from the provider list since `withNoDomReuse` is no longer part of the public API.

steps.title: v17 paramsInheritanceStrategy
steps.action: If you want the child routes of `loadComponent` routes to inherit data from their parent specify the `paramsInheritanceStrategy` to `always`, which in v17 is now set to `emptyOnly`.

steps.title: v18 node support
steps.action: Make sure that you are using a supported version of node.js before you upgrade your application. Angular v18 supports node.js versions: v18.19.0 and newer

steps.title: v18 ng update
steps.action: In the application's project directory, run `ng update @angular/core@18 @angular/cli@18` to update your application to Angular v18.

steps.title: 18.0.0 Upgrade TypeScript
steps.action: Update TypeScript to versions 5.4 or newer.

steps.title: 18.0.0: async has been removed, use `waitForAsync` instead
steps.action: Replace `async` from `@angular/core` with `waitForAsync`.

steps.title: 18.0.0: Deprecated matchesElement method removed from AnimationDriver
steps.action: Remove calls to `matchesElement` because it's now not part of `AnimationDriver`.

steps.title: 18.0.0. Use `@angular/core` StateKey and TransferState
steps.action: Import `StateKey` and `TransferState` from `@angular/core` instead of `@angular/platform-browser`.

steps.title: 18.0.0. Opt-in of caching for HTTP requests with auth headers
steps.action: Use `includeRequestsWithAuthHeaders: true` in `withHttpTransferCache` to opt-in of caching for HTTP requests that require authorization.

steps.title: 18.0.0.REMOVE_OBSOLETE_IS_WORKER
steps.action: Update the application to remove `isPlatformWorkerUi` and `isPlatformWorkerApp` since they were part of platform WebWorker which is now not part of Angular.

steps.title: 18.0.0.FORCE_ZONE_CHANGE_DETECTION
steps.action: Tests may run additional rounds of change detection to fully reflect test state in the DOM. As a last resort, revert to the old behavior by adding `provideZoneChangeDetection({ignoreChangesOutsideZone: true})` to the TestBed providers.

steps.title: 18.0.0: Remove two-way binding expressions in writable bindings
steps.action: Remove expressions that write to properties in templates that use `[(ngModel)]`

steps.title: 18.0.0: Use zones to track pending requests
steps.action: Remove calls to `Testability` methods `increasePendingRequestCount`, `decreasePendingRequestCount`, and `getPendingRequestCount`. This information is tracked by ZoneJS.

steps.title: 18.0.0: Move shared providers to the routed component
steps.action: Move any environment providers that should be available to routed components from the component that defines the `RouterOutlet` to the providers of `bootstrapApplication` or the `Route` config.

steps.title: 18.0.0 Use RedirectCommand or new NavigationBehaviorOptions
steps.action: When a guard returns a `UrlTree` as a redirect, the redirecting navigation will now use `replaceUrl` if the initial navigation was also using the `replaceUrl` option. If you prefer the previous behavior, configure the redirect using the new `NavigationBehaviorOptions` by returning a `RedirectCommand` with the desired options instead of `UrlTree`.

steps.title: 18.0.0: Remove deprecated resource cache providers
steps.action: Remove dependencies of `RESOURCE_CACHE_PROVIDER` since it's no longer part of the Angular runtime.

steps.title: 18.0.0: Update Node.js URL parsing in `ServerPlatformLocation`
steps.action: In `@angular/platform-server` now `pathname` is always suffixed with `/` and the default ports for http: and https: respectively are 80 and 443.

steps.title: 18.0.0. Use absolute URLs
steps.action: Provide an absolute `url` instead of using `useAbsoluteUrl` and `baseUrl` from `PlatformConfig`.

steps.title: 18.0.0. Switch from `platformDynamicServer` to `platformServer`.
steps.action: Replace the usage of `platformDynamicServer` with `platformServer`. Also, add an `import @angular/compiler`.

steps.title: 18.0.0. Remove `ServerTransferStateModule` from app imports
steps.action: Remove all imports of `ServerTransferStateModule` from your application. It is no longer needed.

steps.title: 18.0.0. Update `Route.redirectTo` to accept functions
steps.action: `Route.redirectTo` can now include a function in addition to a string. Any code which reads `Route` objects directly and expects `redirectTo` to be a string may need to update to account for functions as well.

steps.title: 18.0.0: Guards can return `RedirectCommand`
steps.action: `Route` guards and resolvers can now return a `RedirectCommand` object in addition to a `UrlTree` and `boolean`. Any code which reads `Route` objects directly and expects only `boolean` or `UrlTree` may need to update to account for `RedirectCommand` as well.

steps.title: 18.0.0: Mark `OnPush` views dirty
steps.action: For any components using `OnPush` change detection, ensure they are properly marked dirty to enable host binding updates.

steps.title: 18.0.0-Refresh-Newly-Created-Views
steps.action: Be aware that newly created views or views marked for check and reattached during change detection are now guaranteed to be refreshed in that same change detection cycle.

steps.title: 18.0.0: `ComponentFixture.whenStable` matches `ApplicationRef.isStable`
steps.action: After aligning the semantics of `ComponentFixture.whenStable` and `ApplicationRef.isStable`, your tests may wait longer when using `whenStable`.

steps.title: 18.0.0. `ComponentFixture.autoDetect` behavior more closely matches Application behavior
steps.action: You may experience tests failures if you have tests that rely on change detection execution order when using `ComponentFixture.autoDetect` because it now executes change detection for fixtures within `ApplicationRef.tick`. For example, this will cause test fixture to refresh before any dialogs that it creates whereas this may have been the other way around in the past.

steps.title: 19.0.0_ng_update
steps.action: In the application's project directory, run `ng update @angular/core@19 @angular/cli@19` to update your application to Angular v19.

steps.title: 19.0.0-standalone-declarations
steps.action: Angular directives, components and pipes are now standalone by default. Specify "standalone: false" for declarations that are currently declared in an NgModule. The Angular CLI will automatically update your code to reflect that.

steps.title: 19.0.0-remove-this
steps.action:
Remove `this.` prefix when accessing template reference variables. For example, refactor `
{{ this.foo }}` to `
{{ foo }}`

steps.title: 19.0.0-remove-browser-module-with-server-transition
steps.action: Replace usages of `BrowserModule.withServerTransition()` with injection of the `APP_ID` token to set the application `id` instead.

steps.title: 19.0.0-remove-key-value-differs-factories
steps.action: The `factories` property in `KeyValueDiffers` has been removed.

steps.title: 19.0.0_localize_builder_project_option
steps.action: In angular.json, replace the "name" option with "project" for the `@angular/localize` builder.

steps.title: 19.0.0_rename_experimental_pending_tasks
steps.action: Rename `ExperimentalPendingTasks` to `PendingTasks`.

Update tests that relied on the `Promise` timing of effects to use `await whenStable()` or call `.detectChanges()` to trigger effects. For effects triggered during change detection, ensure they don't depend on the application being fully rendered or consider using `afterRenderEffect()`. Tests using faked clocks may need to fast-forward/flush the clock.
Upgrade to TypeScript version 5.5 or later.

steps.title: 19.0.0-timers-in-zone
steps.action: Update tests using `fakeAsync` that rely on specific timing of zone coalescing and scheduling when a change happens outside the Angular zone (hybrid mode scheduling) as these timers are now affected by `tick` and `flush`.

steps.title: 19.0.0-render-default-fallback
steps.action: When using `createComponent` API and not passing content for the first `ng-content`, provide `document.createTextNode('')` as a `projectableNode` to prevent rendering the default fallback content.

steps.title: 19.0.0-hybrid-scheduler-timing
steps.action: Update tests that rely on specific timing or ordering of change detection around custom elements, as the timing may have changed due to the switch to the hybrid scheduler.

steps.title: 19.0.0-router-error-handler
steps.action: Migrate from using `Router.errorHandler` to `withNavigationErrorHandler` from `provideRouter` or `errorHandler` from `RouterModule.forRoot`.

steps.title: 19.0.0-testbed-error-handling
steps.action: Update tests to handle errors thrown during `ApplicationRef.tick` by either triggering change detection synchronously or rejecting outstanding `ComponentFixture.whenStable` promises.

steps.title: 19.0.0-update-resolve-interface-return-type
steps.action: Update usages of `Resolve` interface to include `RedirectCommand` in its return type.

steps.title: 19.0.0-update-fakeasync-to-flush-pending-timers
steps.action: `fakeAsync` will flush pending timers by default. For tests that require the previous behavior, explicitly pass `{flush: false}` in the options parameter.

steps.title: 19.0.0-remove-allow-signal-writes
steps.action: Remove the `allowSignalWrites` option from `effect()` calls. The option is deprecated and no longer required, as signal writes inside effects are allowed by default.

steps.title: 20.0.0_ng_update
steps.action: In the application's project directory, run `ng update @angular/core@20 @angular/cli@20` to update your application to Angular v20.

steps.title: 20.0.0_rename_afterRender_to_afterEveryRender
steps.action: Rename the `afterRender` lifecycle hook to `afterEveryRender`

steps.title: 20.0.0_replace_TestBed_flushEffects_with_tick
steps.action: Replace uses of `TestBed.flushEffects()` with `TestBed.tick()`, the closest equivalent to synchronously flush effects.

steps.title: 20.0.0_update_provideCheckNoChangesConfig
steps.action: Rename `provideExperimentalCheckNoChangesForDebug` to `provideCheckNoChangesConfig`. Note its behavior now applies to all `checkNoChanges` runs. The `useNgZoneOnStable` option is no longer available.

steps.title: 20.0.0_refactor_ng_reflect_attributes_usage
steps.action: Refactor application and test code to avoid relying on `ng-reflect-*` attributes. If needed temporarily for migration, use `provideNgReflectAttributes()` from `@angular/core` in bootstrap providers to re-enable them in dev mode only.

steps.title: 20.0.0_adjust_RedirectFn_return_type_handling
steps.action: Adjust code that directly calls functions returning `RedirectFn`. These functions can now also return an `Observable` or `Promise`; ensure your logic correctly handles these asynchronous return types.

steps.title: 20.0.0_rename_resource_request_to_param
steps.action: Rename the `request` property passed in resources to `params`.

steps.title: 20.0.0_rename_rxResource_loader_to_stream
steps.action: Rename the `request` and `loader` properties passed in RxResource to `params` and `stream`.

steps.title: 20.0.0_replace_ResourceStatus_by_corresponding_strings
steps.action: `ResourceStatus` is no longer an enum. Use the corresponding constant string values instead.

steps.title: 20.0.0_rename_provideExperimentalZonelessChangeDetection
steps.action: Rename `provideExperimentalZonelessChangeDetection` to `provideZonelessChangeDetection`.

steps.title: 20.0.0_update_template_expressions_using_in_property
steps.action: If your templates use `{{ in }}` or `in` in expressions to refer to a component property named 'in', change it to `{{ this.in }}` or `this.in` as 'in' now refers to the JavaScript 'in' operator. If you're using `in` as a template reference, you'd have to rename the reference.

steps.title: 20.0.0_update_router_method_array_parameters_to_readonly
steps.action: The type for the commands arrays passed to Router methods (`createUrlTree`, `navigate`, `createUrlTreeFromSnapshot`) have been updated to use `readonly T[]` since the array is not mutated. Code which extracts these types (e.g. with `typeof`) may need to be adjusted if it expects mutable arrays.

steps.title: 20.0.0_update_animation_tests_for_guaranteed_flushing
steps.action: Review and update tests asserting on DOM elements involved in animations. Animations are now guaranteed to be flushed with change detection or `ApplicationRef.tick`, potentially altering previous test outcomes.

steps.title: 20.0.0_handle_uncaught_listener_errors_in_tests
steps.action: In tests, uncaught errors in event listeners are now rethrown by default. Previously, these were only logged to the console by default. Catch them if intentional for the test case, or use `rethrowApplicationErrors: false` in `configureTestingModule` as a last resort.

steps.title: 20.0.0_update_route_guards_array_types
steps.action: The `any` type is removed from the Route guard arrays (canActivate, canDeactivate, etc); ensure guards are functions, `ProviderToken<T>`, or (deprecated) strings. Refactor string guards to `ProviderToken<T>` or functions.

steps.title: 20.0.0_update_nodejs_version
steps.action: Ensure your Node.js version is at least 20.11.1 and not v18 or v22.0-v22.10 before upgrading to Angular v20. Check the [full list of supported Node.js versions](https://angular.dev/reference/versions).

steps.title: 20.0.0_replace_TestBed_get_with_TestBed_inject
steps.action: Replace all occurrences of the deprecated `TestBed.get()` method with `TestBed.inject()` in your Angular tests for dependency injection.

steps.title: 20.0.0_remove_InjectFlags_usage
steps.action: Remove `InjectFlags` enum and its usage from `inject`, `Injector.get`, `EnvironmentInjector.get`, and `TestBed.inject` calls. Use options like `{optional: true}` for `inject` or handle null for `*.get` methods.

steps.title: 20.0.0_update_injector_get_calls_to_use_ProviderToken
steps.action: Update `injector.get()` calls to use a specific `ProviderToken<T>` instead of relying on the removed `any` overload. If using string tokens (deprecated since v4), migrate them to `ProviderToken<T>`.

steps.title: 20.0.0_update_typescript_version
steps.action: Upgrade your project's TypeScript version to at least 5.8 before upgrading to Angular v20 to ensure compatibility.

steps.title: 20.0.0_set_moduleResolution_to_bundler
steps.action: Set `moduleResolution` to `'bundler'` in your `tsconfig.json`. Angular CLI's `ng update` migration applies this change automatically; if you upgrade manually or override the option in a base tsconfig, set it explicitly so imports of secondary entry-points such as `@angular/core/rxjs-interop` continue to resolve correctly.

steps.title: 20.0.0_review_AsyncPipe_error_handling_in_tests
steps.action: `Unhandled errors in subscriptions/promises of AsyncPipe` are now directly reported to `ErrorHandler`. This may alter test outcomes; ensure tests correctly handle these reported errors.

steps.title: 20.0.0_refactor_PendingTasks_run_usage
steps.action: If relying on the return value of `PendingTasks.run`, refactor to use `PendingTasks.add`. Handle promise results/rejections manually, especially for SSR to prevent node process shutdown on unhandled rejections.

steps.title: 20.0.0_update_template_expressions_using_void_property
steps.action: If your templates use `{{ void }}` or `void` in expressions to refer to a component property named 'void', change it to `{{ this.void }}` or `this.void` as 'void' now refers to the JavaScript `void` operator.

steps.title: 20.0.0_review_date_pipe_formatter_Y_usage
steps.action: Review `DatePipe` usages. Using the `Y` (week-numbering year) formatter without also including `w` (week number) is now detected as suspicious. Use `y` (year) if that was the intent, or include `w` alongside `Y`.

steps.title: 20.0.0_handle_uncaught_listener_errors_in_tests
steps.action: In templates parentheses are now always respected. This can lead to runtime breakages when nullish coalescing were nested in parathesis. eg `(foo?.bar).baz` will throw if `foo` is nullish as it would in native JavaScript.

steps.title: 20.0.0_router_generate_error_redirectTo_and_canMatch_incompatible_together
steps.action: Route configurations are now validated more rigorously. Routes that combine `redirectTo` and `canMatch` protections will generate an error, as these properties are incompatible together by default.

steps.title: 21.0.0_ng_update
steps.action: In the application's project directory, run `ng update @angular/core@21 @angular/cli@21` to update your application to Angular v21.

steps.title: 21.0.0-safe-resource-url-audio-src
steps.action: If you use `SafeResourceUrl` values with `audio[src]` bindings, be aware that `audio[src]` is no longer sanitized in Angular v21. Existing uses of `bypassSecurityTrustResourceUrl` may therefore produce the `SafeValue must use [property]=binding` message. Remove the unnecessary sanitization and bind the URL directly instead.

steps.title: 21.0.0-update-signal-input-access-in-custom-elements
steps.action: When using signal inputs with Angular custom elements, update property access to be direct (`elementRef.newInput`) instead of a function call (`elementRef.newInput()`) to align with the behavior of decorator-based inputs.

steps.title: 21.0.0-zone-scheduler-behavior-change
steps.action: If using `provideZoneChangeDetection` without the ZoneJS polyfill, note that the internal scheduler is now always enabled. Review your app's timing as this may alter behavior that previously relied on the disabled scheduler.

steps.title: 21.0.0-provide-zone-change-detection-required
steps.action: Zone-based applications should add `provideZoneChangeDetection()` to your application's root providers. For standalone apps, add it to the `bootstrapApplication` call. For NgModule-based apps, add it to your root `AppModule`'s `providers` array. An automated migration should handle this.

steps.title: 21.0.0-remove-interpolation-option
steps.action: Remove the 'interpolation' property from your @Component decorators. Angular now only supports the default '{{' and '}}' interpolation markers.

steps.title: 21.0.0-remove-moduleid-property
steps.action: Remove the 'moduleId' property from your @Component decorators. This property was used for resolving relative URLs for templates and styles, a functionality now handled by modern build tools.

steps.title: 21.0.0-ng-component-outlet-content-type-change
steps.action: The `ngComponentOutletContent` input has been strictly typed from `any[][]` to `Node[][]`. Update the value you pass to this input to match the new `Node[][] | undefined` type.

steps.title: 21.0.0-stricter-host-binding-type-checking
steps.action: Host binding type checking is now enabled by default and may surface new build errors. Resolve any new type errors or set `typeCheckHostBindings: false` in your `tsconfig.json`'s `angularCompilerOptions`.

steps.title: 21.0.0-typescript-5.9-required
steps.action: Update your project's TypeScript version to 5.9 or later. The `ng update` command will typically handle this automatically.

steps.title: 21.0.0-remove-application-config-from-platform-browser
steps.action: The `ApplicationConfig` export from `@angular/platform-browser` has been removed. Update your imports to use `ApplicationConfig` from `@angular/core` instead.

steps.title: 21.0.0-remove-ignore-changes-outside-zone-option
steps.action: The `ignoreChangesOutsideZone` option for configuring ZoneJS is no longer available. Remove this option from your ZoneJS configuration in your polyfills file.

steps.title: 21.0.0-testbed-rethrows-errors-with-provideZoneChangeDetection
steps.action: Update tests using `provideZoneChangeDetection` as TestBed now rethrows errors. Fix the underlying issues in your tests or, as a last resort, configure TestBed with `rethrowApplicationErrors: false` to disable this behavior.

steps.title: 21.0.0-router-navigation-timing-changed
steps.action: Update tests that rely on router navigation timing. Navigations may now take additional microtasks to complete. Ensure navigations are fully completed before making assertions, for example by using `fakeAsync` with `flush` or waiting for promises/observables to resolve.

steps.title: 21.0.0-test-bed-provides-fake-platform-location
steps.action: Tests using `TestBed` might be affected by the new fake `PlatformLocation`. If your tests fail, provide the old `MockPlatformLocation` from `@angular/common/testing` via `{provide: PlatformLocation, useClass: MockPlatformLocation}` in your `TestBed` configuration.

steps.title: 21.0.0-remove-upgrade-adapter
steps.action: The `UpgradeAdapter` has been removed. Update your hybrid Angular/AngularJS application to use the static APIs from the `@angular/upgrade/static` package instead.

steps.title: 21.0.0-form-array-directive-conflict
steps.action: The new standalone `formArray` directive might conflict with existing custom directives or inputs. Rename any custom directives named `FormArray` or inputs named `formArray` on elements that also use reactive forms to resolve the conflict.

steps.title: 21.0.0-ngmodulefactory-removed
steps.action: The deprecated `NgModuleFactory` has been removed. Update any code that uses `NgModuleFactory` to use `NgModule` directly, which is common in dynamic component loading scenarios.

steps.title: 21.0.0-emit-declaration-only-not-supported
steps.action: The `emitDeclarationOnly` TypeScript compiler option is not supported. Please disable it in your `tsconfig.json` file to allow the Angular compiler to function correctly.

steps.title: 21.0.0-lastsuccessfulnavigation-is-a-signal
steps.action: The `lastSuccessfulNavigation` property on the Router has been converted to a signal. To get its value, you now need to invoke it as a function: `router.lastSuccessfulNavigation()`.

steps.title: 21.0.0-configure-commonengine-allowed-hosts
steps.action: Starting `@angular/ssr` 21.1.5, if your application uses SSR with `CommonEngine`, set the `allowedHosts` option in your `server.ts` (for example, `new CommonEngine({allowedHosts: ['localhost', '*.yourdomain.com']})`). Without it, SSR silently falls back to client-side rendering. This requirement comes from security advisory [GHSA-x288-3778-4hhx](https://github.com/angular/angular-cli/security/advisories/GHSA-x288-3778-4hhx) (also backported to 20.3.17 and 19.2.21).

steps.title: 22.0.0_ng_update
steps.action: In the application's project directory, run `ng update @angular/core@22 @angular/cli@22` to update your application to Angular v22.

steps.title: 22.0.0-update-nodejs-version
steps.action: Angular v22 requires Node.js v22.22.3 or v24.15.0 and later. Update your Node.js version to meet this minimum requirement. You can check your current version with `node --version`.

steps.title: 22.0.0-update-typescript-version
steps.action: Update your project to use TypeScript 6.0 or later. Versions older than 6.0 are no longer supported. Use `ng update` which will handle this automatically.

steps.title: 22.0.0-data-attributes-input-output-binding
steps.action: Data-prefixed attributes (e.g., `data-*`) no longer bind to inputs or outputs. If you were relying on this behavior, use explicit property bindings instead (e.g., `[attr.data-value]="value"` or `[dataValue]="value"` for a component input).

steps.title: 22.0.0-duplicate-input-output-bindings
steps.action: The compiler now throws an error when inputs, outputs, or model are binding to the same property/output. Review your component decorators and ensure no duplicate bindings exist.

steps.title: 22.0.0-safe-navigation-nullability-narrowing
steps.action: Safe navigation (`?.`) and nullish coalescing (`??`) now correctly narrow down nullable types in templates. This may trigger `nullishCoalescingNotNullable` and `optionalChainNotNullable` diagnostics on existing projects. Either fix the diagnostics by updating your templates, or temporarily disable them in your `tsconfig.json` under `angularCompilerOptions`.

steps.title: 22.0.0-safe-navigation-returns-undefined
steps.action: Angular expressions with optional chaining (`?.`) now return `undefined` instead of `null`. You can use the `$safeNavigationMigration()` magic function to revert to the previous behavior.

steps.title: 22.0.0-resource-stream-synchronous-resolution
steps.action: The `stream` property on `Resource`, including `rxResource`, now resolves synchronously when the stream or observable emits synchronously. Tests that assumed asynchronous resolution may need to wait for the value immediately instead.

steps.title: 22.0.0-remove-in-expressions
steps.action: `in` variables in template expressions now throw an error as it does in native JavaScript. If you have variables named `in` in your component or template, update your template expressions to use `this.in` or rename your variable.

steps.title: 22.0.0-animation-callback-event-signature-change
steps.action: The `AnimationCallbackEvent.animationComplete` signature has changed. Update any code that depends on the old signature of this event. Review your animation event handlers and tests.

steps.title: 22.0.0-http-xhr-backend-explicit-opt-in
steps.action: If your application uses upload progress reporting through `HttpXhrBackend`, explicitly opt-in by using `provideHttpClient(withXhr())`. The default HTTP client no longer includes XHR support by default.

steps.title: 22.0.0-deprecate-report-progress-option
steps.action: The `reportProgress` option in HTTP requests is deprecated. Use `reportUploadProgress` or `reportDownloadProgress` instead for more explicit control over progress reporting.

steps.title: 22.0.0-deprecate-server-xhr
steps.action: XHR support in `@angular/platform-server` is deprecated and is intended to be removed in Angular 23. The underlying `xhr2` library does not safely handle redirects (e.g. it can forward `Authorization` headers on cross-origin redirects and is susceptible to DoS via redirect loops). For server-side rendering, use the default `fetch` backend instead of `withXhr()`.

steps.title: 22.0.0-provide-routes-removed
steps.action: `provideRoutes()` has been removed. Use `provideRouter()` instead, or configure routes as a multi token using `ROUTES` if necessary. Update your application bootstrap configuration.

steps.title: 22.0.0-upgrade-angular-js-global-migration
steps.action: If using AngularJS interoperability, replace deprecated `getAngularLib()` and `setAngularLib()` with `getAngularJSGlobal()` and `setAngularJSGlobal()` respectively.

steps.title: 22.0.0-remove-component-factory-resolver
steps.action: `ComponentFactoryResolver` and `ComponentFactory` are no longer available. Pass the component class directly to APIs like `ViewContainerRef.createComponent()` or use the standalone `createComponent()` function instead.

steps.title: 22.0.0-remove-create-ng-module-ref
steps.action: `createNgModuleRef` has been removed. Use `createNgModule()` instead for dynamic module creation scenarios.

steps.title: 22.0.0-compile-time-duplicate-selectors
steps.action: Elements with multiple matching selectors now throw a compile-time error. Ensure your components use unique selectors and review any directives that might have conflicting selectors.

steps.title: 22.0.0-component-onpush-default
steps.action: Components with no `changeDetection` property defined are now `OnPush` by default. To maintain `Eager` (the previous default) change detection, explicitly set `changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.Eager` in your component decorator.

steps.title: 22.0.0-remove-check-no-changes
steps.action: `ChangeDetectorRef.checkNoChanges()` has been removed. In tests, use `fixture.detectChanges()` instead or verify your component state through other means.

steps.title: 22.0.0-leave-animations-scope-change
steps.action: Leave animations are no longer limited to the element being removed. They now support nested animations scoped to component boundaries. Review your animation configurations if you relied on the previous scoping behavior.

steps.title: 22.0.0-params-inheritance-strategy-default
steps.action: `paramsInheritanceStrategy` now defaults to `"always"` instead of `"emptyOnly"`. This means route parameters are inherited from all parent routes. To restore the previous behavior, explicitly set `paramsInheritanceStrategy: "emptyOnly"` in your router configuration.

steps.title: 22.0.0-can-match-current-snapshot-required
steps.action: The `currentSnapshot` parameter in `CanMatchFn` and the `canMatch` method of the `CanMatch` interface is now required. Update any class implementations of `CanMatch` to include this required third argument.

steps.title: 22.0.0-hammer-js-removed
steps.action: Hammer.js integration has been removed from Angular platform-browser. If you need touch gesture support, implement your own gesture detection or use an alternative library.

steps.title: 22.0.0-app-ref-bootstrap-typing
steps.action: The second argument of `appRef.bootstrap()` no longer accepts `any` type. Ensure the element you pass is not nullable and matches the expected type.

steps.title: 22.0.0-platform-browser-styles-removal
steps.action: Unused styles are now automatically removed when their associated `host` is dropped. Be aware that other DOM on the page may be affected if those styles are used by elements outside of Angular or if not using `ViewEncapsulation.Emulated`.

steps.title: 22.0.0-title-strategy-return-type
steps.action: The return type for `TitleStrategy.getResolvedTitleForRoute` has changed from `any` to a stricter type (e.g., `string | undefined`). Update your custom `TitleStrategy` implementations to match the new signature.

steps.title: 22.0.0-incremental-hydration-default
steps.action: Incremental hydration is now the default behavior for applications using Server-Side Rendering (SSR). Review your application if you relied on the previous non-incremental hydration behavior. You can use `withNoIncrementalHydration()` to restore the previous behavior if needed.

steps.title: 22.0.0-full-template-type-check-removed
steps.action: The `fullTemplateTypeCheck` compiler option has been removed. Use `strictTemplates` instead to enable strict template type checking in your `tsconfig.json`.

steps.title: 22.0.0-strict-templates-default
steps.action: The `strictTemplates` compiler option now defaults to `true`. If your project was not using strict template type checking, you may see new compilation errors. Resolve these errors or explicitly set `strictTemplates: false` in your `tsconfig.json` to opt out.

steps.title: 22.0.0-webpack-builders-deprecated
steps.action: Webpack builders (`@angular-devkit/build-angular` and `@angular-devkit/build-webpack`) are now deprecated. Migrate to the `@angular/build` builders (esbuild/application) for your application builds.

steps.title: 22.0.0-ssr-commonengine-deprecated
steps.action: `CommonEngine` APIs from `@angular/ssr` are deprecated. Migrate to `AngularNodeAppEngine` or `AngularAppEngine` instead.

steps.title: 22.0.0-istanbul-lib-instrument-optional
steps.action: `istanbul-lib-instrument` is now an optional peer dependency. If your project uses Karma with code coverage enabled, ensure `istanbul-lib-instrument` is explicitly installed.

steps.title: 22.0.0-dev-server-port-env-priority
steps.action: `ng serve` now gives the highest priority to the `PORT` environment variable. This value overrides any port configured in `angular.json` or provided via the `--port` flag.

steps.title: 22.0.0-architect-cli-removed
steps.action: The `@angular-devkit/architect-cli` package is no longer available. Use the `architect` CLI tool from the `@angular-devkit/architect` package instead.

steps.title: 22.0.0-experimental-test-builders-removed
steps.action: The experimental `@angular-devkit/build-angular:jest` and `@angular-devkit/build-angular:web-test-runner` test builders have been removed.
